concrete_scene.heading: Worked self-change: the canary passes, the monitor is still open
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A system-proposed routing module, an independent evaluator, a bounded canary, a monitor, a promotion authority, and a prior module
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Promote a self-proposed routing change after early canary traffic looks clean but before delayed-effect monitoring closes.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The candidate remains scoped; a delayed regression triggers restoration and descendant invalidation, while a clean window still requires separate promotion authority.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether self-evaluation, benchmark gain, canary entry, or early clean traffic authorizes promotion; none does.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Candidate, evaluator, monitor, approver, replacement, descendant, compensation, and protected-invariant owners retain distinct residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The finite lifecycle demonstrates custody and rejection, not useful self-improvement, evaluator competence, effect-complete rollback, architectural progress, or recursion.

worked_trace.heading: Worked self-change: the canary passes, the monitor is still open
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The modeled lifecycle separates proposal, evaluation, monitoring, rollback, and promotion authority; useful improvement, independence, recovery, compensation, recursion, and transfer remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The self-ratifying loop promotes after its own benchmark and an early green canary. The governed path keeps the monitor open and promotion authority separate.
readable_claim: Self-improvement begins when a system can propose architectural change, but it becomes governed improvement only when independent gates can reject, monitor, reverse, and reconcile that change.
normative_rule: Separate candidate, evaluator, monitor, approver, and replacement authority. Freeze protected invariants and full state before the proposal, stage exposure, keep the monitor window open through delayed effects, and invalidate every dependent receipt after rollback or promotion.

formal_binding.anchor: candidate may contribute proposals and evidence but cannot solely define

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene states once that finite governance custody is not recursive improvement.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Objective legitimacy, state completeness, independence, monitoring, rollback, compensation, invalidation, utility, recursion, support, and release remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The canary and delayed monitor stay reader-facing; the 118-route lifecycle remains in formal evidence.
